label: Assistant Reply
description: Single file attachment in an assistant reply. Best for a full width report card under a reply paragraph, with type and size and a secondary download button.

label: Composer Tray
description: Composer tray with removable attachments. Best for a chat textarea topped by xs chips that scroll sideways, a paperclip that adds files and a live attached count.

label: Image Strip
description: Image thumbnails in a snapping strip. Best for vertical image cards whose full card button marks one as pressed and prints its name and dimensions below.

label: Three Sizes
description: Three sizes carrying three levels of an answer. Best for default, sm and xs cards stacked under text labels to rank a deliverable, its working files and cited snippets.

label: Upload Queue
description: Upload queue across all five states. Best for each of the 5 states on its own row, with a spinner while uploading, a retry on the failure and cancel or remove labels by state.

label: File Picker
description: File picker that fills an attachment tray. Best for a dashed idle card that opens the system dialog, then lists picks as sm rows with image previews, sizes and limit errors.
